pr_title: Serialise and deserialise `SkinInfo.InstantiationInfo` to allow for more correct imports
pr_body:
Until now, skins were always imported using the `LegacySkin` instantiation type. For cases where a user has edited the lazer or classic default (via the new skin editor), which would result in incorrect fallback paths after exporting and importing the edited skin.

- Closes #15896
- [x] Depends on #15859.

issue_context.title: Modified default skin exports don't import with the correct `InstantiationInfo`
issue_context.body:
The type is not serialised anywhere on export, so it's not feasible to correctly import such cases back. Currently all imported skins get the default type as per: https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/f6a3709060b3ba4d81ce4f9d01df52aba7fa18dd/osu.Game/Skinning/SkinInfo.cs#L40-L45 ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/15895
Originally posted by **puyoxyz** December 2, 2021 I tried importing an OSK file with *just the JSON file with the HUD layout* and it works, but it's using the classic default skin. Is there a way to import a JSON HUD layout into the osu!lazer skin, or fall back to osu!lazer skin elements instead of the classic skin elements?

review_comments: Is this just to fix up the potential `string.Empty` case if an exception is thrown above, or does this serve some secondary purpose?
Yeah, I have a TODO which is to go through each serialisable model and make them explicit include only for json, but it does make sense to fix this one here while we're at it I guess.

I've made this opt-in now, looks like this:

```json
{
  "Name": "osu! (triangles) (modified)",
  "Creator": "Unknown",
  "InstantiationInfo": "osu.Game.Skinning.DefaultSkin, osu.Game"
}
```
